🎬 Repo Man (1984)

Repo Man follows Otto Maddox, a rebellious young punk rocker living in Los Angeles whose life takes an unexpected turn when he becomes involved in the dangerous world of automobile repossession. After meeting an experienced repo man named Bud, Otto begins tracking down vehicles, encountering eccentric criminals, strange characters, and bizarre situations. Things become even more chaotic when a mysterious 1964 Chevrolet Malibu attracts the attention of government agents, criminals, and UFO enthusiasts. As Otto searches for the valuable car, he uncovers a strange conspiracy involving extraterrestrial secrets and unpredictable dangers. Combining dark comedy, science fiction, punk-rock culture, and outrageous storytelling, the film explores rebellion, alienation, greed, and the absurdities of American society.

🎭 Genre: Sci-Fi • Comedy • Crime • Cult Classic

⭐ IMDb: 6.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 32m • R

🎥 Director: Alex Cox

🏆 Recognition: Starring Emilio Estevez and Harry Dean Stanton, the film became a cult classic of 1980s independent cinema, celebrated for its punk-rock soundtrack, unconventional humor, and distinctive visual style.

source_details.synopsis: Repo Man is a 1984 American science fiction black comedy film written and directed by Alex Cox in his directorial debut. It stars Harry Dean Stanton and Emilio Estevez, with Tracey Walter, Olivia Barash, Sy Richardson, Vonetta McGee, Fox Harris, and Dick Rude among the supporting cast. Set in Los Angeles, the plot concerns a young punk man (Estevez) who is recruited by a car repossession agency and gets caught up in the pursuit of a mysterious Chevrolet Malibu that might be connected to extraterrestrials.
